nodes.label: golangci-lint Config
nodes.rationale: Schema v2; defaults (errcheck, govet, ineffassign, staticcheck, unused) plus bodyclose, gosec, revive (dot-imports) requested in issue #60. staticcheck ST1000 is excluded because every file opens with the Jetstack copyright header rather than a 'Package X' doc comment (house style, not a defect). Test files and test/ get lighter treatment (no bodyclose/errcheck/gosec; revive and ST1001 allowed for Ginkgo/Gomega dot-imports); hack/ skips revive. Formatters: gofmt, goimports.
